name: Bojek
source:
An aged dwarf wielding an enormous hammer. A thoughtful man with a calmness befitting his age. His perpetually furrowed brow gives others the impression of sullenness, but stuffing his mouth with his favourite meatpies lights up his expression.

He strongly believes Dwarves can live anyway provided there is stone and fire. Because he's disinterested in retaking the lands of his ancestors, there's a distance between him and his fellow kin in Dantor.

[Spoiler] He is frequently accosted by younger members of his race to join them in their quest to retake the mountain in order to restore lost glories. He rejects the advances each time as he understands an armed revolt to retake the mountain would displace many peoples who had made the shallower mountain regions their home. He is more interested in keeping the blacksmith techniques of Dantor's dwarf forebears alive as that to him has far more worth than the now abandoned ancestral realm.

A regular at the public house who always orders meat pie and ale. [/Spoiler]
